title: Emergency Heating
description: Compares safe indoor heating (fireplaces, wood stoves, propane and kerosene heaters with caution) and lists what never to use indoors. Covers isolating and insulating one room, layering and sleeping warm, improvised heat sources, fuel storage, CO poisoning symptoms, and when to leave.
shortDescription: Safe indoor heat sources, warming one room, and carbon monoxide safety
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
